summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving and strengthening the E-Rate program to ensure reliable broadband access for students and maintain essential school operations. They urge the FCC to reject proposals that would eliminate or sunset E-Rate and instead advocate for preserving and improving the program.

claims.argument: E-Rate support is essential for maintaining school connectivity and infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Hewlett-Woodmere Union Free School District has received $223,560 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $44,712 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
